title: Android Developer I
text:
Koel Mobility builds the app 2 lakh auto-rickshaw drivers use to find rides.

What you'll do
- Build features in Kotlin for our Android app
- Integrate REST APIs and handle offline sync
- Write unit tests for business logic

Requirements
- Kotlin (Java is acceptable if you're willing to switch)
- Android SDK and Jetpack libraries
- Git

Plus points
- Jetpack Compose
- Experience publishing an app on the Play Store
